integrity: All finite counts are reconstructed from the metric definition by deterministic standard-library code. The full-isometry order is independently matched by constructing \(1440\) distance-preserving maps and compared with the published order.
scientific_limitations: Finite exact classification for the block-transposition metric on \(S_5\) at minimum distance \(3\); no larger-\(n\) extrapolation. Full-isometry exhaustion uses the published automorphism-group order \(1440\).
title: Exact diameter-code census in the block-transposition metric on \(S_5\)
